grants.description: Verify your identity using your Government Gateway credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your MTD enrolment to your existing HMRC tax records

grants.description: Allow HMRC to access your digital tax records kept in MTD-compatible software
grants.purpose: HMRC needs to receive your VAT returns and Income Tax updates digitally through your software

grants.description: Share your HMRC taxpayer reference with your chosen MTD-compatible software provider
grants.purpose: Your software needs these references to submit returns and updates to HMRC on your behalf

grants.description: Confirm your business information for MTD enrolment
grants.purpose: To set up your MTD account correctly and ensure compliance deadlines are accurate

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC or manage through your Government Gateway account. Note: If MTD is mandatory for you, you cannot opt out but can change software provider.
revocation.effect: Enrolment will be cancelled only if MTD is not yet mandatory for you. If mandatory, you must use an alternative MTD-compatible software provider.

delegation.agent_identity: GOV.UK AI Agent or Tax Agent
delegation.limitations: Agent cannot select software on your behalf without explicit approval. Agent cannot revoke MTD enrolment if mandatory. Agent cannot access or modify your accounting records within the software - only the software connection to HMRC. Tax agents must be separately authorised through HMRC's agent services.
